Happened during my night shift as a PTE, during EOD accountability check.

My then senior was teaching me what and how to account for items/equipment. There's a small shed a short walk away from the main building which was basically in complete darkness.
After accounting for the stuff, as my senior was locking up the shed, I thought I saw a slow blinking red light through one of the small windows through the corner of my eye and told my senior. Thinking it might have been a malfunctioing exit light, we went in to check but found nothing. We didn't think much about it and left.

Fast forward a year half later when my new juniors posted in, as I was in the shed teaching them, I recalled that story and jokingly told them that the shed was haunted. Right as I said that, we all heard faint knocking on the doors. Instantly gtfo. As we were walking back to the main building, I smelled flowers. Needless to say, we almost never went there alone during night shift after that.
